lines.zh: 用头冠敲打地面，发出轰鸣声。
lines.en: Rattle the crest, creating a loud rumble.

lines.zh: 缓慢移动，双足支撑身体。

lines.en: Bend down to graze, munching on the grass.
Step through the grass, leaving prints.

lines.zh: 发出短促的叫声，寻找同伴。
lines.en: Call out briefly to locate companions.

lines.zh: 尾巴轻轻摆动，帮助平衡。
lines.en: Swish the tail gently for balance.

lines.zh: 移动时发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Make a soft hissing sound while moving.

lines.zh: 长头冠低低地扫过草尖
lines.en: My long crest sweeps the tips of the grass.
My three toes leave shallow prints.

lines.zh: 用尾巴扫开挡路的枝条
lines.en: My tail brushes aside the branches.
I walk following a scent in the air.

lines.zh: 用鼻子轻触周围的植物。
lines.en: Gently touch plants with the nose.

lines.zh: 用头冠轻触地面，感受振动。
lines.en: Gently touch the ground with the crest, feeling vibrations.

lines.zh: 在阳光下休息，享受温暖。
lines.en: Rest in the sun, enjoying the warmth.

lines.zh: 用舌头舔食身上的苔藓。
lines.en: Lick moss off the body with the tongue.
Search for food in the grass.
I press my crest against a herd mate's.
I lift my head to listen far off.
I scratch my neck with a hind leg.

lines.zh: 发出警告声，准备保护同伴。
lines.en: Warn with a sound, ready to protect companions.

lines.zh: 低头注视玩家，准备攻击。
lines.en: Lower the head to focus on the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的叫声，询问玩家意图。
lines.en: Make a low call, inquiring about the player's intentions.

lines.zh: 用鼻孔观察玩家的动态。
lines.en: Sniff to observe the player's movements.

lines.zh: 我的头冠一响，整群都听见。
lines.en: One note from my crest and the herd hears.

lines.zh: 用头冠轻轻触碰玩家，试探。
lines.en: Gently touch the player with the crest, testing.
My nostrils flare, reading your scent.
I turn my crest toward you.

lines.zh: 你靠近了，我要保护我的族群！
lines.en: You're getting too close, I'll protect my kind!

lines.zh: 尝尝我的呼吸吧，很美味！

lines.en: Can you smell it? This grass is fragrant!
Look at my crest, it's tough!

lines.zh: 让暴风雨来得更猛烈些吧！
我的牙齿能切碎任何东西！
我的皮肤厚实，不易受伤！
lines.en: My skin is thick, hard to hurt!

lines.zh: 我只吃植物，从不伤害同伴！
lines.en: I only eat plants, never harm my kin!

lines.zh: 我的力量可以保护我们！
我们体型巨大，不会轻易退让！
lines.en: Our size won't let us back down!

lines.zh: 你撞我腿侧，我的尾鞭已经抬起。
lines.en: You hit my flank, and my tail is already up.

lines.zh: 我的头冠能碰撞出火花！

lines.en: Be wary of my tail whip, it's dangerous!

lines.zh: 我们用身体碰撞来表达力量！
lines.en: We use body collisions to show strength!

lines.zh: 我们用叫声来警告入侵者！
lines.en: We warn intruders with our calls!

lines.zh: 我的体型庞大，难以被击败！
lines.en: My size makes me hard to defeat!

lines.zh: 我的肌肉紧实，力量无穷！
lines.en: My muscles are strong, full of power!

lines.zh: 找到合适的伴侣，繁衍后代！
我的族群需要更多的成员！

lines.en: Let our love echo in the valley!
We convey feelings with our crests!
Find a partner, create the future!

lines.zh: 我们互相吸引，共同生活！
lines.en: We attract each other, live together!

lines.zh: 我的头冠里响起低音，传得很远。
lines.en: A low note sounds in my crest and carries far.

lines.zh: 头冠一响，整群都听见了。
lines.en: One blast from my crest and the herd hears it.
You touched one of my herd.
My bellow rolls across the field.
My foreleg tears up the dirt.

lines.zh: 锁定目标准备发动攻击

lines.en: I turn side-on, aiming my crest at you.
I herd you toward open ground.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音越来越低
lines.en: The sound in my throat drops lower.
I close in with a heavy sway.
Two herd mates follow behind me.
Smash your head with my crest!
My crest is a deadly weapon!
Crush your bones with my crest!
My crest will knock you down!
Strike your soul with my crest!
My crest slams into your ribs.

lines.zh: 前脚踩碎了脚边的石头
lines.en: My forefoot crushes a stone beside you.
My tail sweeps across your knees.
My whole bulk bears down on you.
I stay here, protecting my home!
I come to defend my territory!

lines.zh: 我的存在，就是这片地的标志！

lines.en: A note from my crest first.
This is my place of rest!
A hairline crack splits the egg.
My crest breaks the shell first.
The hatchling wobbles to its feet.

lines.zh: 第一声鸣叫回荡在谷里
lines.en: My first call echoes down the valley.
It follows the herd toward the river.

lines.zh: 考古坑旁多了一串脚印
lines.en: A new track appears by the dig site.

lines.zh: DNA 拼出了完整的骨架
lines.en: The DNA resolves into a whole skeleton.

lines.zh: 草地上站起一头副栉龙
lines.en: A Parasaurolophus rises on the grass.

lines.zh: 我从陡坡滚落，膝盖先撞到石。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope and strike my knee.
Ahh... I fell into the void...
